title: Projected Lax conjecture
exact_target: For every real homogeneous polynomial hyperbolic in direction $e$, is its closed cone $K(p,e)$ exactly the set of $x$ for which some $u\in\mathbb{R}^a$ makes $A_0+\sum_i x_iA_i+\sum_j u_jB_j$ positive semidefinite, for some finite $a$ and finite real symmetric matrices, without taking the closure of the projection?
